_source: DOMINION D16 (Evil Mode rework): Team Snagem and Team Cipher (plans/evil-mode-rework/04_THE_OPPOSITION.md §9, changed by 09_ADOPTED_FROM_THE_DRAFTS.md A23 the feud and A14 'Syndicate: Snagem and Cipher deals'), the Partnership screen (A23), the Trust they bring (A19: snagged 1, Shadow 0 until purified) and the fifteen Boss actions of section AC 'Snagem and Cipher Deals' (lists/player-actions-301-450.md rows 376-390). Text is data; every number a rule reads is here.

snagem.name: Team Snagem
snagem.gives: The Snag Machine and Snag Balls: take an adult trainer's Pokémon in battle.
snagem.takes: 15% of all income, and 1 Pokémon a week from the Reserve (their pick, the best one).
snagem.raises: Heat +10% on everything you do; the Hero's Threat climbs faster.

cipher.name: Team Cipher
cipher.gives: The Shadow Machine in a Shadow Lab: close a Pokémon's heart. Shadow moves, more power, no levels until it's purified, and it may act on its own.
cipher.takes: 15% of all income, and 1 Shadow Pokémon every 2 weeks for their army.
cipher.raises: Dread rises fast in the towns you hold; the Hero's Threat climbs much faster; the heroic Legendaries come sooner.

feud.line: Snagem and Cipher both work for you now, and they hate each other.

snagem.text: Snagem broke into the Shadow Lab: the Shadow Machine is down for {days} days.

cipher.text: Cipher hijacked Snagem's van: {n} Snag Balls lost this week.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.text: Walk away for free. They take back what they gave, take one more Pokémon on the way out, and tip off the police.

buyout.name: Buy out
buyout.text: Pay them off and part as friends.

purge.name: Purge
purge.text: Fight their people, one after another, to the leader. Win and you keep what they built. Lose and the cut goes up.

lines.offer: {team} sends word: they'll work with a Syndicate. The terms are on the Partnership page (J).
lines.notYet: {team} doesn't deal with small fry. Reach Syndicate first.
lines.closed: You informed on them to Looker. Snagem and Cipher won't deal with you again this run.
lines.already: You already have a deal with {team}.
lines.ended: {team} won't deal with you again in this region.
lines.signed: Deal made with {team}: {cut}% of every week's income from now on. {gift}
lines.giftSnagem: Gonzap's men fit a Snag Machine to your arm and leave {n} Snag Balls on the Snag Desk.
lines.giftCipher: Cipher's scientists wheel a Shadow Machine into a new Shadow Lab.
lines.cut: {team} took their {cut}% of the week's income: ₽{n}.
lines.cutNone: {team} looked at the week's books: no income, no cut.
lines.tookMon: {team} took {mon} from the Reserve for their own.
lines.tookShadow: Cipher took {mon}, a Shadow Pokémon, for their army.
lines.noMon: {team} wanted a Pokémon and found none they liked: {n}% more of the income instead.
lines.balls: Snagem's van dropped off {n} Snag Balls.
lines.renegDown: {team} is afraid of you: their cut drops to {cut}%.
lines.dread: Cipher's people walk your towns: Dread +{n} in every town you hold.
lines.cancelSnagem: They took the Snag Machine, the Snag Desk and the Snag Balls, and {mon} on their way out.
lines.cancelCipher: They took the Shadow Machine and the Shadow Lab, and {mon} on their way out.
lines.boughtOut: You paid {team} ₽{n}. The deal is over, and they leave as friends.
lines.keepsDesk: The Snag Machine and the Snag Desk stay.
lines.noKeep: The Shadow Machine goes with them.
lines.noMoney: The buy-out is ₽{n}. You don't have it.
lines.purgeWon: {leader} is beaten. {team} is gone from this region, and what they built is yours.
lines.purgeLost: You lost to {name}. {team} laughs it off and raises the cut by {n}%.
lines.shadowed: The Shadow Machine closes {mon}'s heart. Trust 0 until it's purified.
lines.machineUsed: The Shadow Machine is cooling down. Use it again next week.
lines.machineBroken: The Shadow Machine is broken until Day {day}.
lines.machineNone: Nothing here to put in the machine.
lines.purified: {mon}'s heart opens. It's purified, and trusts the team ({n}).
lines.soothed: {mon}'s heart eases a little: {heart} left to go.
lines.noShadow: There's no Shadow Pokémon to work on.
lines.traded: Cipher's dealer hands over {mon}, a Shadow Pokémon, Lv {level}. It goes to the Reserve.
lines.tutorNone: None of your Pokémon can learn a Shadow move now.
lines.sold: You sold {mon} on the black market for ₽{n}.
lines.soldNone: You have no snagged Pokémon to sell.
lines.snagFight: You pick a fight with someone worth snagging from. A Snag Ball is ready.
lines.snagHit: You walk out with {n} Snag Balls. Snagem will remember it.
lines.sabotage: You sabotage a Cipher plan: they skip their next Shadow Pokémon. Cipher will remember it.
lines.meet: {team} likes how you talk: their cut will be {n}% lower at the next renegotiation.
lines.snagged: {mon} was snagged and goes to the Reserve (Trust {n}).
lines.snaggedFull: {mon} was snagged, but the Reserve is full: it was let go.
lines.looker: Snagem and Cipher hear you talked to Looker. Every deal is off, for the rest of the run.
lines.dealerShadow: The dealer's Shadow Pokémon, {mon}, goes to the Reserve.

screen.title: PARTNERS
screen.both: Both deals: {pct}% of income gone before wages, and they sabotage each other every week.
screen.locked: Snagem and Cipher only deal with a Syndicate. Grow the team first.

snagem-meet.win: You meet a Snagem contact in {district}.

snagem-heist.win: A heist with Snagem in {district}: your half is ₽{pay}.
snagem-heist.lose: The heist goes wrong, and Snagem runs first.

cipher-offer.win: You hear Cipher's terms in {district}, and push back.
cipher-offer.lose: Cipher's go-between walks out on you.

shadow-pokemon-trade.win: Cipher's dealer has something for you.
shadow-pokemon-trade.lose: The dealer smells police and leaves.

purify-rite.win: You sit with a Shadow Pokémon through the evening.
purify-rite.lose: It won't let you near it tonight.

snag-ball-use.win: You go looking for a Pokémon worth snagging in {district}.
snag-ball-use.lose: They see the Snag Machine coming.

peon-rank.win: A Cipher peon badge for every member: Loyalty +2.

admin-rank.win: Cipher admin ranks handed out: Loyalty +3.
admin-rank.lose: The ranks start a fight instead.

cipher-lab.win: A night in Cipher's lab: Wits +XP.
cipher-lab.big: A night in Cipher's lab, and you work out a new Shadow move.
cipher-lab.lose: The lab's notes make no sense tonight.

snagem-base-hit.win: You hit a Snagem base in {district}.

shadow-sabotage.win: You get into a Cipher plan in {district}.

shadow-tutor.win: Cipher's tutor comes by in the evening.

black-market-snag.win: A buyer in {district} likes snagged Pokémon.
black-market-snag.lose: The buyer was a cop. You walk away fast.

cipher-lab.note: Plays as Wits XP; the top level's "a new Shadow move" is the big line (Shadow Tutor teaches the moves).
